name: Orihime Yuna ~Tsunagareta Futari no Seijo~
original_name: 檻姫ユナ ～繋がれた2人の聖女～
source:
In the large and powerful kingdom of Albus, the hand of a demon draws nearer and nearer to the next successor of the throne, Princess Yuna.

The tragic tale of the princess and her protector, a holy knight named Tenel who would give her life to protect Yuna, is just beginning, as the demons have made the princess their target...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036864.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在幅员辽阔、实力强大的阿尔布斯王国，恶魔之手正一步步逼近王位继承人尤娜公主。

公主与守护她的圣骑士特内尔之间的悲剧故事才刚刚开始；恶魔已经将公主定为目标……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036864.html]DLsite English[/url]]
